text:
Type: rectangular drop-leaf dining table
Use: dining, extra seating when needed; dining room, kitchen
Style: rustic, farmhouse, Scandinavian
Materials: untreated solid pine with visible knots
Colors: light natural pine
Shape: long rectangular top, single hinged drop leaf at one end, plain apron, four tapered square legs, simple and sturdy, medium visual weight
Feel: natural, homey, warm, relaxed
Goes with: wooden or painted chairs, white walls, linen and greenery; farmhouse kitchens, cabins or Scandinavian dining rooms
